# UX Audit: ABY

## Before Starting
1. Read `AGENTS.md` and `.ai/project_profile.yaml`
2. Open the relevant screens or flows end-to-end
3. Note which parts of the experience feel unclear, busy, or inconsistent

## Audit Focus

### 1. Clarity
- Check whether every screen says what it is for in plain language
- Verify that primary actions are obvious and visually dominant
- Look for vague labels, hidden states, or confusing transitions

### 2. Trust and feedback
- Confirm loading, success, error, and empty states are easy to understand
- Make sure AI-generated output is clearly framed as suggested, not guaranteed
- Ensure destructive or irreversible actions require confirmation

### 3. Accessibility and comfort
- Check contrast, spacing, focus states, and keyboard flow
- Prefer readable copy over clever wording
- Look for motion or UI density that may feel overwhelming

### 4. Consistency
- Match terminology across pages, modals, toasts, and navigation
- Keep button labels, section names, and status text aligned
- Watch for repeated patterns that should behave the same way everywhere

### 5. High-end polish
- Reduce clutter on premium or high-value screens
- Keep the visual hierarchy crisp and intentional
- Suggest small refinements that make the product feel calm, modern, and trustworthy
